title: 报表检视器「期间与导出」：默认期间下拉显示原始值（this_month），没有选项名
body:
triage#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZKP5YM48rWMWTS7wE

Filing gate: ① a product defect with a named site, filed by triage at repo:objectstack#3's request (mailbox #36743, comment 7120950453). Source: seat 3's ux-D dev on #36447 (PR #36814), outside that card.

## What happens

In the Studio report inspector, under 「Period & export」, the Default Period select lists each option by its stored preset (`this_month`, `this_quarter`, …) in both en and zh-CN. `packages/spec/src/ui/report.form.ts` draws `dateRange` as a `composite` row (l.122 on `origin/main`), and the `dateRange.defaultRange` enum carries no option labels in the form, so the select falls back to the raw value.

reach: reported by the dev from the running inspector; the form gap was read on `origin/main` here. It reaches every builder who sets a report's default period.

## Expected

Each preset reads as a period name in the builder's language (for example "This month" / 「本月」), the same way other enum selects in Studio forms read.

## Acceptance

- The Default Period select shows labelled options in en and zh-CN, with the locale packs following the repository's usual rule for new user text.
- A pin that the `defaultRange` options in the report form carry labels.

Dedupe: open issues for `defaultRange` return only #36447 (in flight; the panel's row wording, not the option text).
